name: @agents-js/example-registry-sync-smoke
description: Smoke example for cross-gateway registry sync. Stands up two real createGatewayTestServer gateways backed by tests/mock-acp-agent.cjs, enables A2A peer-sync between them via startRegistrySync + createSyncEndpointHandler, and proves gateway A discovers gateway B's (name, url) record through the real pull-merge path — then confirms the synced URL points at a reachable gateway by fetching B's agent card.
